hits.text: Eric Bauza has sadly passed away at the age of 46. The modern voice of Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck alongside many other beloved characters.
hits.hook: Eric Bauza has sadly passed away at the age of 46. The modern voice of Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck alongside many other beloved characters.
hits.draft_en: Eric Bauza voiced Bugs and Daffy for a whole generation that never noticed the handoff. That's the biggest compliment a voice actor can get. Drop the Looney Tunes line you still hear in his voice. RIP.
hits.video_tip: 20-25s tribute: open on a black title card with his name and age, then 3-4 short clips of his best-known reads with captions, end on a 'Which line is yours?' card.

hits.hook: Amanda Seyfried explains why she turned down playing Gamora in 'GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY': 'This is not going to be a hit...'
hits.draft_en: Amanda Seyfried turned down Gamora because a talking tree and raccoon in space sounded like a career-ender. Honestly, fair. What's the turned-down role you think still stings the most?
hits.video_tip: List video: 5 famous turned-down roles, 2-3s each, actor face plus the role they passed on as a card. First frame shows Seyfried and the quote.

Poster drops + 'trailer tomorrow' teasers (DUNE: PART 3, BLADE RUNNER 2099)
Box office numbers vs budget (WICKER, KLARA AND THE SUN, CLAYFACE)
Marketing stunts / ARG (WERWULF 35mm + Snapchat full-moon clue)
Anniversary hooks ('12 years ago', 'released 42 years ago today')
Engagement questions ('rate X out of 10', 'name a movie where...')

narrative_synthesis: Candid quotes and a death notice drove the day (Potts 7.5M, Bauza 3.0M, Seyfried 1.5M on DiscussingFilm). Dune: Part 3 poster wave sets up tomorrow's trailer; box-office-vs-budget math keeps landing for FilmUpdates.
